body:
## Finding

The runnable coverage report shows only 11.3% statement coverage for `journal`. Persistence, lifecycle, and error-handling paths are largely untested.

## Recommendation

Add deterministic unit tests covering journal creation/opening, record persistence and reload, malformed or unavailable storage, and lifecycle/error branches. Include the package in a reproducible repository-wide coverage run once embedded assets are available.

## Priority
- Impact: high
- Effort: medium

## October 10 evidence reconciliation

Fresh focused journal coverage on assessment source `47a60ea78c5d97c892177f5649a1c950399faa6a` was 11.6% (`CC=/usr/bin/gcc go test -cover ./journal`), versus the issue's historical 11.3%. Create/append/reload, malformed records, unavailable location and forced-home cleanup tests exist, but persistence/lifecycle/error-path coverage remains incomplete. Embedded prerequisites now work (#130/#180 closed); this does not close the journal testing scope.

The root-reviewed assessment and raw focused coverage are retained under `work/rcc-swarm/evidence/remaining-triage.md` and `remaining-focus-coverage.log`. This reconciliation adds current disposition evidence; it leaves the issue open and does not promote #185 governance authority.
